tool_input.description: Check FastDatePrinter behavior for unterminated quote and unknown pattern letter

result:
All 63 tests across the three classes pass, and no stray files remain in the project (not a git repo, so no `git status` output, but the directory listing confirms only the original files plus `src`/`target`).

Created three self-contained JUnit 5 test classes under `src/test/java/org/apache/commons/lang3/time/`:
- `FastDateFormatAgentTest.java` — covers factory caching/equality, null/invalid pattern errors, format across `Date`/`Calendar`/`millis`/`Object` overloads, parse round-trips and failure cases, style constants, and `toString`/`getMaxLengthEstimate`.
- `FastDateParserAgentTest.java` — covers constructor null-argument errors, parse success/failure (including `ParsePosition` error indices and partial consumption), two-digit-year century pivot boundaries, `equals`/`hashCode`, defensive `TimeZone` copying, unsupported pattern letters, and week-year parsing.
- `FastDatePrinterAgentTest.java` — covers constructor defaults, `format` consistency across overloads, the different time-zone-handling behavior between the `Appendable` and deprecated `StringBuffer` `Calendar` overloads, unsupported-type errors in `format(Object, ...)`, `equals`/`hashCode`, `parsePattern`/`parseToken`/`selectNumberRule`, year padding, and time-zone offset pattern variants.
